title: Settlement Agreements Same-Client Bundle Figures by Programme
content:
# Settlement Agreements — Same-Client Bundle Figures

Two figures of each programme of Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements describe the same-client bundle, in which every open account placed under one client agreement is settled together: the percentage points by which the floor is lowered for the bundle, and the smallest number of accounts in a qualifying bundle.

| Figure | Prompt-Pay Discount Settlement | Lump-Sum Settlement | Two-Payment Settlement | Three-Payment Settlement | Six-Payment Settlement | Hardship Settlement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bundle floor reduction (percentage points) | 0.0 | 3.0 | 2.0 | 2.0 | 0.0 | 0.0 |
| Smallest number of accounts in a qualifying bundle | 0 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 0 | 0 |

## Reading the figures

- A reduction of 0.0 means the programme has no bundle reduction, and a minimum of 0 marks a programme where bundles are not offered: the Prompt-Pay Discount Settlement, the Six-Payment Settlement and the Hardship Settlement.
- The Lump-Sum Settlement carries the largest bundle reduction, 3.0 percentage points; the Two-Payment and Three-Payment Settlements carry 2.0.

## Hypothetical illustration

For a hypothetical Lump-Sum bundle, a floor of 55.0 percent lowered by the 3.0-point bundle reduction reads 52.0 percent.
